subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should OpenClaw extend the Feishu plugin from group sender/topic session isolation and DM dynamic agents into automatic group per-sender subagent lifecycle management?
rationale: The remaining work crosses product behavior, security boundaries, memory isolation, skills/config ownership, quotas, cleanup, and channel delivery semantics; current main has adjacent primitives but no approved default for group auto-spawning.

options.title: Design default-off Feishu group subagents
options.body: Approve a bounded Feishu-plugin design with explicit configuration, security policy, lifecycle limits, and live Feishu validation before implementation.

options.title: Keep existing session scoping
options.body: Treat groupSessionScope plus manual/thread-bound subagent flows as the supported path and document automatic group subagents as out of scope for now.

options.title: Prototype externally first
options.body: Ask interested teams to prove the design as a separate Feishu or ClawHub integration until a missing core/plugin API is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Design default-off Feishu group subagents
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded Feishu-plugin design with explicit configuration, security policy, lifecycle limits, and live Feishu validation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested behavior is primarily Feishu plugin product/security behavior, and package metadata names this handle as the Feishu community-maintained owner signal.
